During emergency, a 30-minute prior notice required must be approved by the Manager Airport Ground Operations and Safety Division (AGOSD) of Manila International Airport Authority (MIAA) and/or his representative. Airlines' request for exemption to utilize the runway during closure brought by other operating requirements beyond emergency situation must be coordinated with all other concerned offices (for example, Manila Tower/Civil Aviation Authority of the Philippines, Operations Center/Philippine Aeronautical Rescue and Coordination Center/Manila International Airport Authority (MIAA) Engineering and Command Center/Airlines) and shall also be approved by the assistant general manager for operations of Manila International Airport Authority (MIAA) and/or his representative.
